sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Tonic of Ratatosk is a Swamp-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Ratatosk.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Mead base: Ratatosk is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 10 Blueberries
• 1 Cured squirrel hamstring
Six Tonics of Ratatosk are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: Consuming it increases player walking and running speed by 15%, and swimming speed by 7.5%.

Tonic of Ratatosk

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadHasty | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Ratatosk x1 | Duration: 10m | Cooldown: 0s | Other Effect(s): +15% walking and running speed, +7.5% swimming speed

Introduction. Tonic of Ratatosk is a Swamp-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Ratatosk.

Recipe. Mead base: Ratatosk is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 10 Blueberries
• 1 Cured squirrel hamstring
Six Tonics of Ratatosk are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

Effect. Consuming it increases player walking and running speed by 15%, and swimming speed by 7.5%.
